title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: A young nobleman and his family take control of a desert planet that holds the universe's most valuable resource. Politics and prophecy collide as he is pushed toward a destiny he fears.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
description: A washed-up hacker is hired for one last job inside a vast computer network. A gritty story that helped invent the cyberpunk genre.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
description: An envoy visits a frozen world whose people have no fixed gender. A thoughtful story about trust and friendship across cultures.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
description: A mathematician predicts the fall of a galactic empire and creates a plan to shorten the dark age that follows. A classic of big-idea science fiction.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: An astronaut is stranded alone on Mars and must use science and humor to survive until rescue. Fast and easy to read.

title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
description: A gifted child is trained in a space military academy to fight an alien enemy. The story questions the cost of turning children into soldiers.

title: Snow Crash
author: Neal Stephenson
description: A pizza delivery driver and hacker fights a mysterious virus that spreads in both the virtual world and real life. Fast and darkly funny.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A comfort-loving homebody joins a band of dwarves to reclaim a mountain treasure guarded by a dragon. A gentle adventure ideal for beginners.

title: A Wizard of Earthsea
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
description: A proud young wizard releases a dark shadow and must hunt it across the sea. A short and wise coming-of-age tale.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: A famous innkeeper tells the story of how he became a legendary magician. Rich in music and magic school details.

title: American Gods
author: Neil Gaiman
description: An ex-convict becomes the bodyguard of a mysterious man and is drawn into a war between old gods and new ones. A road trip through modern America.

title: Good Omens
author: Terry Pratchett and Neil Gaiman
description: An angel and a demon who have grown fond of Earth try to stop the end of the world. A very funny comedy about the apocalypse.

title: The Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: Soldiers and scholars on a storm-swept world struggle over an ancient war. A huge epic with a detailed magic system.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A sharp-witted young woman and a proud wealthy man misjudge each other in a society obsessed with marriage and money. Famous for its irony and romance.

author: George Orwell
description: A low-level clerk in a totalitarian state secretly begins to rebel against constant surveillance and rewritten truth. A warning about power and propaganda.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A girl in a small Southern town watches her father defend a Black man falsely accused of a crime. A moving story about justice and prejudice.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A mysterious millionaire throws lavish parties in hope of winning back his lost love. A short novel about the American dream and its emptiness.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: A scientist brings a creature to life and then abandons it in horror. A gothic tale about responsibility and loneliness.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: A poor student commits a murder and is tormented by guilt while a detective closes in. A deep psychological study of conscience.

title: The Stranger
author: Albert Camus
description: A detached man in Algiers is put on trial after a killing on a sunny beach. A short existential novel about meaning and indifference.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
author: Agatha Christie
description: A famous detective investigates a murder aboard a snowbound train where every passenger has a secret. A perfect puzzle mystery.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
description: A journalist and a skilled hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance in a powerful family. A dark and gripping thriller.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: A wife vanishes on her anniversary and suspicion falls on her husband. A twisting thriller about marriage and lies.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Sherlock Holmes investigates a family curse and a giant spectral dog on a foggy moor. A classic detective adventure.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A sweeping history of humankind from early hunters to modern societies. It asks how shared stories let humans cooperate at huge scale.

title: Guns Germs and Steel
author: Jared Diamond
description: An explanation of why some societies gained power and technology before others. It focuses on geography and environment instead of race.

title: The Silk Roads
author: Peter Frankopan
description: A history of the world told through the trade routes linking East and West. It shows how commerce shaped religion and empires.

title: A People's History of the United States
author: Howard Zinn
description: American history told from the perspective of workers and minorities rather than leaders. A debated but influential account.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits through small daily changes. Packed with simple tools anyone can apply.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
description: An argument that focused work without distraction is increasingly rare and valuable. It offers strategies for protecting concentration.

title: Mans Search for Meaning
author: Viktor Frankl
description: A psychiatrist reflects on surviving concentration camps and finding purpose in suffering. A short and powerful read.

title: Thinking Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: A Nobel-winning psychologist explains the two systems that drive human thought and the biases they create. A tour of decision-making research.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: An accessible introduction to black holes the Big Bang and the nature of time. Written for readers with no physics background.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
description: A gene-centered view of evolution that explains cooperation and conflict in nature. It also introduced the idea of the meme.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
description: A poetic journey through the universe and humanity's search to understand it. A great introduction to astronomy for general readers.

title: The Immortal Life of Henrietta Lacks
author: Rebecca Skloot
description: The story of a woman whose cells were taken without consent and became vital to medical research. It explores ethics and race in science.

title: Long Walk to Freedom
author: Nelson Mandela
description: The autobiography of the South African leader from his rural childhood to prison and the presidency. A story of resistance and reconciliation.

title: Steve Jobs
author: Walter Isaacson
description: A biography of the Apple co-founder based on many interviews. It portrays a brilliant and difficult perfectionist.

title: Educated
author: Tara Westover
description: A woman raised in an isolated survivalist family teaches herself enough to reach university. A memoir about family loyalty and learning.

title: Born a Crime
author: Trevor Noah
description: A comedian recounts growing up under apartheid as the child of a Black mother and white father. Funny and touching.

title: Alice in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: A bored girl falls down a rabbit hole into a world of absurd logic and strange creatures. A playful classic for children and adults.

title: The Little Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupery
description: A pilot stranded in the desert meets a small boy from another planet. A gentle fable about love and what really matters.

title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
author: Roald Dahl
description: A poor boy wins a tour of a mysterious candy factory run by an eccentric inventor. A funny story with a moral touch.
